about: Made by tools/art-import/import_art.py. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script.
frameFormat: [page, x, y, w, h, trimX, trimY, fullW, fullH]

name-plate.note: BLANK. The game renders the name (Fredoka/Andika). Top-centre sits ~6 px under the enemy's feet. Fades out after 3 s (rule from the proposal).

name-tag.note: BLANK. Appears (fade in ~0.3 s) when the under-feet name-plate has faded. Bottom-centre sits headOffsetPx[enemy] above the enemy's ground point. The ONLY thing drawn above any head. Small font (Fredoka/Andika). headOffsetPx covers idle, wind-up and attack poses (highest head + 10 px), so the tag never moves or overlaps during a tell.

journal-silhouette-brute.note: unmet treatment: flat warm grey #786c5c + soft inner light; place in the card's picture well (10,10)-(126,126)

journal-silhouette-swarmer.note: unmet treatment: flat warm grey #786c5c + soft inner light; place in the card's picture well (10,10)-(126,126)

journal-page-frame.note: phone page; paper area (22,22)-(366,573); title banner centred at y 30; 3 cards at x 36, y 92 / 252 / 412

journal-title-banner.note: BLANK; the game writes the title "Monster Journal"

journal-card-unmet.note: "?" baked in the name slot (from the proposal); the game may write "Keep exploring!" in textArea

sticker-brute.note: Home Dojo wall sticker (final): die-cut, thick white border, gold keyline, gold sparkles. Given once, on the first win vs that named monster. Same wall-item rules as home-dojo/static.json.

tell-stamp-dust.layer: under the enemy, over the floor and danger circle
tell-stamp-dust.note: Old Thumper stamps twice. Same wind-up length (0.8 s); the tell only adds to the warning. Same for all 8 directions (ground effect).

tell-dash-trail.drawnFor: dash direction +x (E); rotate about anchorPx to the real dash angle (ground plane: also squash y by 0.5 for N/S dashes)

tile.note: repeat along +x from the frame's right edge to the dash end

tell-dash-trail.layer: under enemies, over the danger circle
tell-dash-trail.note: Zippy Zoom: shows the exact path it will dash along. Wind-up stays 0.6 s.

timing.sound: clank x3 at the same times

tell-shield-tap.note: Captain Clank taps three times. Draw the sheet at the enemy anchor shifted by offsetPerFramePx[dir][current wind-up frame] (the shield rises during the wind-up, so it must follow the frame). offsetPerDirectionPx = frame 0 only, kept for old code. Wind-up stays 0.7 s.
